critical.issue: Returns 500 'KeyError: confidence_rating' when any horse in the field is REJECTED by calculate_horse_score (e.g. <3 runs or unapproved track). The rejected return dict only contains keys: score, max_score, verdict, criteria_breakdown — but build_recommendations() (server.py line 425 in trifecta builder, and similarly the win/place/safety builders) accesses h['place_score']['confidence_rating'] and h['place_score']['star_rating']. Reproduce: any live race with a young horse / first-time runner triggers this. test_analyze_live_race confirms it on today's racecards.

rca_of_the_issue: calculate_horse_score has TWO early-return paths (unapproved track at line 152-157, insufficient form at line 165-173) that return a minimal dict {score, max_score, verdict, criteria_breakdown}. The normal return path at line 298-308 returns a richer dict including confidence_rating, star_rating, recommendation. Downstream build_recommendations() unconditionally accesses h['place_score']['confidence_rating'] / ['star_rating']. With live data, races commonly contain young horses with <3 runs of form, triggering the rejection path → KeyError → 500. Fix: either (a) make the rejection dict include the missing keys with default values, or (b) use .get() in build_recommendations().
